items.title: Mom Left Babysitter's Body in Cemetery After She Went to Watch Kids, Was Shot
items.summary:
A Virginia mother abandoned a 17-year-old’s body in a cemetery after the girl arrived at the woman’s home to babysit her children and was shot, prosecutors said.

Now, more than seven years later, Simone Worrell has been sentenced to 26 years in prison on murder and other charges in Nye’Tazia Hicks’ death, per The Virginian-Pilot .

Hicks was shot in the torso after she arrived at Worrell’s Portsmouth home to watch Worrell’s children, while other juveniles were also at the residence the evening of July 27, 2019, according to the Portsmouth Commonwealth’s Attorney’s Office .

One of the children ultimately accessed an unsecured gun from a hallway closet.

Babysitter Sentenced for Murdering Missing Boy After She Helped With Search 

Hicks tried to take the gun away from the juvenile, but the weapon went off, striking Hicks and causing both of them to fall backward, prosecutors said.

The boy tried to put pressure on Hicks’ wound and went to call 911, but Worrell intervened and told him not to call for help, according to prosecutors. Afterward, he fled the home.

The boy was Domonique White, who was 14 and ran to his parents’ home not far from Worrell’s residence, The Virginian-Pilot reported.

White, now 21, testified against Worrell at trial in February and reportedly said he had retrieved the gun from Worrell’s closet to show the firearm to Hicks, whom he said he had been dating.

“Being a kid back in the day, I thought it was cool,” White said, per the newspaper. “We were messing around.”

After stopping White from getting help, Worrell took Hicks’ body to Evergreen…
items.t: Mom Left Babysitter's Body in Cemetery After She Went to Watch Kids, Was Shot

items.title: 2 Texas Men Dead After Hostage Situation Ends in Apparent Murder-Suicide
items.summary:
Two men were found dead inside of a home in Gillespie County, Texas, after a hostage situation resulted in an apparent murder-suicide, according to authorities.

The Gillespie County Sheriff’s Office said in a press release shared via Facebook that deputies responded to a home on Cemetery Road in Stonewall, Texas, shortly after 5 p.m. on Wednesday, November 18, after they received reports of a disturbance that involved a man with a gun.

Deputies began communicating with the victim inside the residence via phone during the incident, and he told deputies that an armed man would not allow him to leave the home.

Because the incident was treated as a hostage situation, deputies made multiple attempts to communicate with both the suspect and victim so that the conflict could hopefully end in a peaceful resolution.

Argument Between Roommates Leads to Murder-Suicide in Las Vegas, Says Police 

Authorities said they lost communication with the men for several hours. Law enforcement then entered the home around 3:30 a.m. on Thursday, November 19, and they found both men dead in a room.

Investigators ultimately determined that the incident was a murder-suicide involving a 35-year-old suspect and a 49-year-old victim.

The Gillespie County Sheriff’s Office said that they worked on the case with the help of the Kerr County Sheriff’s Office Special Operations Unit, Texas Department of Public Safety Special Operations Unit and a Texas Ranger.

Authorities have not yet released the men’s identities as they await to notify next of kin. It’s not currently clear how the two men knew each…
items.t: 2 Texas Men Dead After Hostage Situation Ends in Apparent Murder-Suicide

items.summary:
Lance Broadway , a former pitcher for the Chicago White Sox and New York Mets, died unexpectedly on Tuesday, November 17. He was 43.

“Some heartbreaking news: Former TCU and DBU pitcher Lance Broadway has passed away,” Jamie Plunkett , a Texas Christian University sports reporter for HornedFrogBlitz.com, announced via X on Wednesday, November 18.

“Broadway earned 2005 CUSA Pitcher of the Year and First-Team All-American honors from Baseball America, posting a 1.61 ERA and 151 strikeouts in 117 innings in his lone season as a Horned Frog,” Plunkett continued. “Following that season, he was selected 15th overall in the 2005 MLB Draft by the Chicago White Sox. He made his MLB Debut on Sept. 7, 2007, and also spent time with the Mets and Blue Jays organizations.”

The post concluded, “Broadway also briefly stepped into acting, appearing in the 2013 film Olympus Has Fallen as well as a handful of television and short film projects.”

Frederick M. Brown/Getty Images

Emilee Guzman was arrested on Wednesday, November 18, after the Monongalia County Sheriff’s Office began investigating allegations of medical child abuse and child neglect that involved a 2-year-old and a 9-year-old, according to a criminal complaint viewed by Us .

The Monongalia County Sheriff’s Office confirmed in a press release that Guzman, 29, has been charged with child neglect resulting in serious bodily injury.

Munchausen syndrome by proxy is a mental illness and a form of child abuse in which the “caretaker of a child, most often a mother, either makes up fake symptoms or causes real symptoms to make it look like the child is sick,” according to Medline Plus .

items.summary:
Sean “Diddy” Combs is celebrating Thanksgiving behind bars, marking his first major holiday at his Pennsylvania prison.

Us has obtained FCI Allenwood Low’s food menu outlining what Diddy, 57, and his fellow inmates will be offered on Thursday, November 26 — and the real question is: turkey or tofu?

The low-security facility is serving up all the fixings of a traditional Thanksgiving meal, including mashed potatoes and gravy, candied sweet potato casserole, sage and onion stuffing, dinner rolls and green bean casserole.

But when it comes to the main course, Diddy and his fellow inmates will get to choose between eight ounces of Turkey or tofu stir-fry.

Dia Dipasupil/Getty Images 
 For dessert, only one kind of pie will be on the menu. FCI Allenwood Low tells Us , it’ll be dishing out pecan pie to the prisoners. Page Six was first to report the news.

This is Diddy’s third Thanksgiving in lockup, but his second since being convicted on two charges of transportation to engage in prostitution in July 2025. He was acquitted on two counts of sex trafficking and one count of racketeering conspiracy. In October 2025, Diddy was sentenced to 50 months in federal prison.

In November 2024, the Bad Records Founder spent the holiday in custody at Brooklyn’s Metropolitan Detention Center while awaiting trial.

items.title: ‘Days of Our Lives’ Actor Larry Poindexter Dead at 66 After Being Hit by Car
items.summary:
Soap star Larry Poindexter died on Wednesday, November 18, five days after being hit by a car. He was 66.

A vehicle struck Poindexter while he was crossing the street to pick up food in the Studio City neighborhood of Los Angeles on Friday, November 13, according to Deadline .

Poindexter was subsequently hospitalized and had been scheduled to undergo surgery for broken ribs on Wednesday before he suddenly died. 

His official cause of death has not been shared at this time. Poindexter is survived by his wife, Carol Kritzer , whom he married in 2002, and their twin sons.

‘Days of Our Lives’ Actor Robert Kelker-Kelly Dead at Age 62 

Poindexter’s career spanned four decades, with roles including LAPD Captain Tom Fuller in 2003’s S.W.A.T . He also appeared in 30 episodes of Days of Our Lives , playing two characters: Ben Welch in 1984 and Father Louis from 2014 to 2018. Poindexter was also in several episodes of General Hospital and Santa Barbara. 

“My family was in the biz, but I didn’t start ’til I was 19,” he said during a 2011 interview with Santa Barbara Online about how he got his start in the industry. “I did summer stock theater [musicals] in the chorus, then moved on to working straight plays and then television and movies. My first on-camera job was a TV movie called Thursday’s Child — I played Rob Lowe’s brother.”
